lesson_title: Night in Brazil, Morning in Durban
hook_text: It is sunrise on Durban beach. So why is a class in Brazil yawning in their pyjamas?
clip_script: Durban, 6 a.m. The Sun pops out of the Indian Ocean. Video call to São Paulo: it is 1 a.m. there! The secret? Earth spins on its axis, once in about 24 hours. The side facing the Sun has day. The side facing away has night. We spin from west to east, so the Sun seems to rise in the east and set in the west. The Sun never switches off. We just turn away from it.
visual_style: Whiteboard globe lit by a torch, with stars on Durban and São Paulo turning from dark into light.
mood: Bright and surprised, then curious and satisfied.
pacing: Quick sunrise, quick video-call twist, then a steady spin of the globe.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and try the torch and globe at home.
